title: Vietnamese Comte Noodle Soup
description: A soothing and comforting soup that combines the creaminess of Comte cheese with the delicate flavors of Vietnamese cuisine. This recipe serves a hearty, satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cut the Comte cheese into small cubes.
Wrap the noodles in lightly flaky pastry dough to create cheese-filled pockets.
Bake the pastry pockets for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
In a large pot, combine the vegetable broth and water. Bring to a boil.
Add the baked pastry pockets to the pot and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.
